scenes.text: Rectangles have four right angles and equal opposite sides. A square also has four equal sides.
How many right angles does a rectangle have? The answer is 4. Every rectangle has four right angles.
A rectangle during a reading competition is 9 cm long and 15 cm wide. Which pairs of sides have equal lengths? Pause the video and think.

A rectangle during a reading competition is 9 cm long and 15 cm wide. Which pairs of sides have equal lengths? The answer is opposite sides. The two long sides are equal and the two short sides are equal.
